title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation's MediaWiki software, specifically in the Translate Extension. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the file includes/Output/OutputPage.php. It affects multiple versions of MediaWiki from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.1.
